build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable number of experts and MOLE dropout for mixture of experts
merge_mole_model_backbone: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MOLE layers into standard linear layers for single-dataset inference optimization
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper that routes predictions through dataset-specific MOLE experts using a head class
build_expert_mapping: build a dataset to expert index mapping from a dataset mapping dict using the _build_expert_mapping method
create_single_head_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper that shares one head across multiple datasets with per-dataset output routing
